nl: 售后维修管理：查询有订单号；表格展示订单号、服务方式、是否保价、寄回地址；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「寄回地址」在服务方式为上门服务，或已保价时隐藏（上门无需寄回、保价件走专线收件）。
nlEn: After-sales repair management: query by order number; the table shows order number, service type, insured flag and return address; supports add, edit and delete. In the form, the "return address" is hidden when the service type is on-site, or the item is insured (on-site needs no return, insured items use a dedicated pickup line).
notes: AI-16: 表达式 isHidden（跨字段 or）—— 上门服务或已保价时隐藏寄回地址（vue2/schema）
